slides.title: A boundary or a *punishment*?
slides.sub: From the outside they can look the same.

slides.title: A boundary is about you.
slides.body: It says what you will do. "If the yelling starts, I'll leave the room." It holds whether they change or not.

slides.title: A punishment is about them.
slides.body: It's built to make them feel it. The silent treatment. The withheld yes. The point is the sting.

slides.title: Ask one quiet question.
slides.body: Would this still work if they never noticed? A boundary would. A punishment only works if it hurts.
